source_path: Floom original. Written on 2026-10-11 for a joint launch with Compound (compound.mov), the video editor that cuts the drafted scripts into posts.
note: The method: collect a founder's own recent work (Claude Code and Codex session logs, git history, company docs), keep only moments with a source, and draft LinkedIn posts, X posts and 30 to 60 second video scripts with a source map under every draft. scripts/collect.py was written by Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code; it runs on the user's computer, reads only, makes no network call and redacts keys, tokens, emails and phone numbers. The skill never posts. It is not derived from an upstream skill.
